_readme: Every retailer starts with enabled=false. Before enabling one, read that site's terms of use; if they forbid automated collection, leave it off (or ask the retailer for a price feed).
Domains below were NOT verified when this file was written; the first run's report shows which ones work.
Optional per retailer: 'sitemaps' (extra sitemap URLs), 'product_url' (regex a product page URL must match), 'delay' (seconds between requests).
Test one retailer without enabling it: python scripts/fetch_online_prices.py --only "Jaya Grocer" --max-pages 30 --dry-run
